title: GM Construction Assistance & Low-Friction Spatial Authoring
delivered_capability: Recognize/suggest/confirm projections cover rooms, boundaries, openings, paths and structural roles over authorized stable SSA references.

Governed semantic metadata and confirmed authoring may project as confirmed semantics; unconfirmed recognition and generated assistance remain proposal-first and pixels, visual adjacency and image recognition remain non-authoritative.
Fast manual correction uses versioned idempotent owner-operation proposals and never bypasses owner validation, permissions or canonical mutation authority.
Reusable construction kits remain permission-filtered authoring assistance rather than canonical construction state.
Unusual-space authoring reuses completed topology semantics while preserving Transition, Portal, Reality, Permission and movement authority; no silent movement or Reality mutation occurs.

Hidden/GM-only construction semantics and protected cardinality are filtered before projection, consequential assistance requires accessible nonvisual summaries, and no durable SSA-07 persistence, migration 0022, provider-media authority or SSA-08 ownership was introduced.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: SSA-07 converged after three evidence-driven validation-contract repairs and one administrative PR-state workaround. Governed-start run 33340085643 first exposed an invalid convergence failure-class enum and was repaired before application mutation. Initial RED-profile run 33340288168 then exposed invalid TEST_UNIT blame metadata; changed head 13913c3d158f73fcf4c6ceaf1bb00c5b0a1376f1 reached the intended TDD RED in run 33340313808 because the contract and panel did not exist. After production implementation, run 33340427229 exposed a zero-fanout verifier contract mismatch because the active profile literally named a completed predecessor; profile-only repair aa9afdbacaf8ea3d0f1d2b3709a1ed7ed8967968 then passed selector/Linux/Windows/comparator in run 33340463706. The connected ready-for-review mutation subsequently failed because its GraphQL response queried a nonexistent Repository.fullDatabaseId field; draft PR 357 was therefore closed and non-draft PR 358 was opened at the identical validated head. GitHub automatically emitted unchanged-head run 33340571100, which passed, and PR 358 merged as 61ff10cd825f925caf6f898e03f623c87be73ca7.
diagnostic_hypotheses: Repeated failures were validation/profile contract defects rather than product-behavior failures once the intended TDD RED had been observed.
Literal predecessor identifiers in the one active Validation Core profile can violate the zero-historical-fanout guard even when no predecessor workflow is invoked.

The final merge obstruction was repository PR draft state caused by a connector GraphQL schema defect, so replacing only the PR wrapper while preserving the validated source head would unblock merge without source mutation.
